# Verify all songs and albums in library are liked by re-fetching all pages
def fetch_all(api_func, access_token):
    all_items = []
    page_index = 0
    page_limit = 20
    while True:
        page = api_func(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
        all_items.extend(page)
        if len(page) < page_limit:
            break
        page_index += 1
    return all_items

# Fetch full song library and liked songs
song_library = fetch_all(apis.spotify.show_song_library, access_token)
liked_songs = fetch_all(apis.spotify.show_liked_songs, access_token)

# Fetch full album library and liked albums
album_library = fetch_all(apis.spotify.show_album_library, access_token)
liked_albums = fetch_all(apis.spotify.show_liked_albums, access_token)

# Compute missing songs and albums
library_song_ids = {song['song_id'] for song in song_library}
liked_song_ids = {song['song_id'] for song in liked_songs}
missing_songs = library_song_ids - liked_song_ids

library_album_ids = {album['album_id'] for album in album_library}
liked_album_ids = {album['album_id'] for album in liked_albums}
missing_albums = library_album_ids - liked_album_ids

print(f"Missing songs: {missing_songs}")
print(f"Missing albums: {missing_albums}")
